import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Complex Filter Function Metric Finset
open scoped BigOperators Topology

theorem weighted_summable_majorant_complex_partial_sums (a : ℕ → ℂ) (g : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hmajorant : Summable g)
    (hdom : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖a n‖ ≤ g n)
    (c : ℕ → ℂ)
    (hc : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖c n‖ ≤ 1)
    (s : ℕ → ℂ)
    (h : s = (fun n : ℕ => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, c i * a i)) :
    ∃ y : ℂ, Tendsto s atTop (𝓝 y) := by
  subst s
  have ha_norm : Summable (fun n : ℕ => ‖a n‖) :=
    Summable.of_nonneg_of_le
      (fun n => norm_nonneg (a n))
      hdom
      hmajorant
  have hprod_le : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖c n * a n‖ ≤ ‖a n‖ := by
    intro n
    calc
      ‖c n * a n‖ = ‖c n‖ * ‖a n‖ := norm_mul _ _
      _ ≤ 1 * ‖a n‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hc n) (norm_nonneg (a n))
      _ = ‖a n‖ := one_mul _
  have hprod_norm : Summable (fun n : ℕ => ‖c n * a n‖) :=
    Summable.of_nonneg_of_le
      (fun n => norm_nonneg (c n * a n))
      hprod_le
      ha_norm
  have hprod : Summable (fun n : ℕ => c n * a n) :=
    Summable.of_norm hprod_norm
  refine ⟨∑' n : ℕ, c n * a n, ?_⟩
  exact hprod.hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat
